participation.context: Looked at the folded sheet and added nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You did not rewrite the letter. You left it folded for Hobbins.

title: Left the Sunday sheet as it was

participation.context: Gave Hobbins the Sunday sheet, left the hand undecided, and put the lower sentence away unread to the yard.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Took the twopence and the sheet, asked if it was good news, and did not turn the answer into a smile.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

participation.context: Looked at the horses, left before the letter was opened, and did not hear the house's news.
participation.name: Gilbert Shakespeare

relations.note: twopence the letter, and the news left as news

story.body: You paid twopence, heard the cough was gone, and did not read the different-ink sentence into the yard. Gilbert left before the sheet was open.

relations.note: twopence the letter, and the news left as news

participation.context: Read the lower line quickly and did not make it a sum he owed tonight.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept the sentence on the sheet and out of the talk. You did not reckon fourteen and six, and you did not answer it.
